documents.title: What eDoc Demo is
documents.text: eDoc is an experimental online appointment platform. You can browse specialties, synthetic demo doctors, and simulated sessions. People, clinics, and bookings in this environment are not real medical records and must not be used for actual care.

documents.title: What a Demo Appointment means
documents.text: Demo means a sandbox. The badge DEMO – Simulated Appointment marks a practice booking, not a real visit with a licensed clinician. Demo doctors show a Demo Doctor badge. No real license numbers or patient ratings are presented as genuine.

documents.title: Language
documents.text: Arabic is the default interface language (RTL). Switch to English from the language link in the header or sidebar.

documents.title: User roles
documents.text: There are three roles: patient (patient/ console), doctor (doctor/ console), and admin (admin/ console). After login you are sent to the matching console.
